card.name: Sentence ends in recipe instructions
card.fires_on: Periods (and some linking words) ending a step in cooking or preparation instructions, right before the next step begins. Often the next step starts with a verb like Heat, Combine or Place.

modes.label: Period after a step
modes.description: The full stop closing a recipe step, such as rubbing, patting or mixing.

modes.label: Linking word between steps
modes.description: A joining word or comma inside a step where a heating action comes next.
modes.example: Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position<< and>> heat oven to 300 degrees

modes.label: Mixing instructions in medicine
modes.description: A period after a stir or mix instruction in dosing directions.

card.writes: It pushes the next sentence to begin with a cooking verb such as Heat, Combine or Place.
card.plain: It marks the end of a recipe step and prepares the model for the next instruction, often about heating or combining.
